capabilities: : Keep vaults running in the background
: Distinguish vaults with custom icons and badges
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer. It is a maintained fork of another community plugin.
intentEvidence: Keep desktop Obsidian vaults—and Obsidian Sync—available in the background without blocking logout, restart, or operating-system shutdown.
problem: Standard application behavior terminates or hides the vault process when the window is closed or the application is quit, potentially interrupting Obsidian Sync.

relations.evidence: Run in Background is a maintained fork of dragonwocky/obsidian-tray, originally created by dragonwocky.

summary: Keeps desktop Obsidian vaults running in the background on macOS and Linux, allowing Obsidian Sync to continue processing changes even when the vault window is hidden.
